# venice-bridge

> venice-bridge is a free, open-source local bridge for macOS that lets OpenCode and other OpenAI-compatible coding agents use a venice.ai web subscription, with working tool calls.

## What it does

- Runs an OpenAI Chat Completions server on `127.0.0.1:18891` (`POST /v1/chat/completions`, `GET /v1/models`, `GET /health`, `POST /reload`).
- Forwards requests to the venice.ai web app's own backend, signed in with the user's browser login (the `__client` cookie of `clerk.venice.ai`). It does not use the paid Venice API and needs no API key.
- Emulates tool calling in text: the tool list goes into the system prompt, and a tolerant parser turns the model's reply into OpenAI `tool_calls`. Includes retries, a completion check, a stream gate, and an optional early-stop judge.

## Install

- Requirements: macOS, Python 3.10+, `pip install curl_cffi`, a paid venice.ai web plan (Pro).
- Save the cookie value to `~/.config/venice-bridge/client-cookie.txt` (mode 0600).
- Run `python3 venice_bridge.py`, then check `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:18891/health`.

## Use

- OpenCode: copy the provider block from `examples/opencode.json` into `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`, then `opencode -m venice-bridge/deepseek-v4-1-flash-uncensored`.
- Any OpenAI-compatible client: base URL `http://127.0.0.1:18891/v1`, any placeholder API key.
- Autostart on macOS with the launchd template `examples/com.example.venice-bridge.plist`.

## Limits

- Unofficial; not affiliated with Venice.ai. Uses undocumented web endpoints that can change at any time.
- Automating a logged-in web session may be against Venice's terms of service; use only your own account.
- Free Venice accounts get `403 creator_access_required`.
- macOS only so far. No Anthropic Messages or OpenAI Responses API, so Claude Code and Codex CLI do not work directly. No images.
- Tool calling is emulated; open models sometimes need a retry.
